title: Normalized coefficient slice comparison data
statement: For a scheme X and a small pro-etale object U, fix arbitrary commutative ring sheaves O on X and B on U, an isomorphism c:u inverse O ≅ B, and the normalized inverse-image/restriction comparison delta [lem-sfb-proetale-object-inverse-image-restriction]. Let R=O restricted to U, b=c delta_O inverse, r the sectionwise exact module restriction and E restriction of scalars along b inverse. Given presentations S, SR, SB of the ordinary unbounded derived closed tensor structures and their canonical K-flat models [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], TensorData records the ordinary comparison u* ≅ r E, the chain and derived tensor comparisons for r and E with their exact localization squares, and the three ordinary unit comparisons. TensorNormalized asserts their distinguished-section, pure total-tensor generator and unit formulas, plus agreement of the composite derived tensor/unit comparison with canonical pullback. Data additionally records natural slice, scalar and pullback internal-Hom isomorphisms. Normalized adds scalar equivalence, equality of these Hom maps with the transposes of the transported evaluations, and the explicit composite formula under localized delta. CoefficientClosedComparisonLaws denotes the evaluation, transpose and symmetry equations. All data and equations are exactly those formerly in the parent module; no object is selected by this definition.

proof.text: Construct the comparison data interface using the existing ordinary and derived functors and the published tensor and closed presentations; the fields retain the original section and representative equations. For the exactness theorem used by derived restriction, apply the already proved public proEtaleSliceModules_exact from lem-per-proetale-scalar-slice-comparison. Its sectionwise pushforward functor is definitionally proEtaleSliceModuleRestriction; no coefficient or geometric hypotheses change.
